name: Fujing Holdings Co., Limited
summary: Fujing Holdings Co., Limited is an investment holding company that grows, processes and sells potted vegetables in China, supplying mainly restaurants and hotels. Its vegetable range includes crown daisy, rapeseed, frisee, Indian lettuce, pak choi, lettuce, Chinese celery and tatsoi. It was established in 2006, is based in Qingdao and is a subsidiary of Wider International.
